question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing cheerleader, Dave is playing benchwarmer, Eve is playing right back, Fred is playing striker, and Gertrude is playing fullback.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Fred trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Eve and Fred trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) goalkeeper
(C) cheerleader
(D) benchwarmer
(E) right back
(F) striker
(G) fullback
solution:
Positions are listed in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: center midfielder, goalkeeper, cheerleader, benchwarmer, right back, striker, fullback.
1. Eve ↔ Bob: center midfielder, right back, cheerleader, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, striker, fullback.
2. Dave ↔ Alice: benchwarmer, right back, cheerleader, center midfielder, goalkeeper, striker, fullback.
3. Bob ↔ Fred: benchwarmer, striker, cheerleader, center midfielder, goalkeeper, right back, fullback.
4. Gertrude ↔ Claire: benchwarmer, striker, fullback, center midfielder, goalkeeper, right back, cheerleader.
5. Bob ↔ Eve: benchwarmer, goalkeeper, fullback, center midfielder, striker, right back, cheerleader.
6. Dave ↔ Gertrude: benchwarmer, goalkeeper, fullback, cheerleader, striker, right back, center midfielder.
7. Eve ↔ Fred: benchwarmer, goalkeeper, fullback, cheerleader, right back, striker, center midfielder.
Alice is the benchwarmer, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
